description: This file defines an interface for a timer system, including factory and timer classes, with methods for creating, canceling, and checking timers. It also includes an enumeration for timer types.

classes.name: ITimerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating ITimer instances, providing a static method to get the factory instance and a method to create timers.

classes.name: ITimer
classes.description: Interface for timer objects, with methods to cancel the timer and check if it is active.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of the ITimerFactory.

methods.name: createTimer
methods.description: Creates a new timer with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently active.
